_about: Expected MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs per log file in data/logs/. Used by evaluate.py for precision/recall/F1. Source logs: Cyber-Agent mordor_dataset (OTRF Security-Datasets, Atomic Red Team simulations).

bitsadmin_download.json.attack_summary: cmd.exe runs 'bitsadmin.exe /transfer' to download a file from GitHub into the user's folder (Atomic Red Team T1197).

techniques.T1197: BITS Jobs - bitsadmin.exe creates a BITS transfer job
techniques.T1105: Ingress Tool Transfer - a file is downloaded from the internet onto the host

service_mod_fax.json.attack_summary: 'sc config Fax binPath=' points the Fax service at powershell.exe, 'sc start Fax' runs it as SYSTEM, then the binPath is restored (Atomic Red Team T1543.003).

techniques.T1543.003: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service - Fax service binPath is changed
techniques.T1059.001: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell - powershell.exe is launched by services.exe

mshta_javascript.json.attack_summary: cmd.exe runs mshta.exe with a javascript: one-liner that loads a remote .sct scriptlet from GitHub via GetObject, which launches calc.exe (Atomic Red Team T1218.005). Held-out test: no rules tuned on this log.

techniques.T1218.005: System Binary Proxy Execution: Mshta - mshta.exe executes attacker-supplied JavaScript
techniques.T1059.007: Command and Scripting Interpreter: JavaScript - JavaScript code is run via the javascript: protocol

_stage9_protocol: Entries below were written on 13 Oct 2026 from the attack commands (Sysmon EID 1) and the Mordor/Atomic test names only, and committed BEFORE the pipeline was run on these logs. Rule: expected = the technique the test simulates + any other technique clearly and specifically shown by an attack command.

logon_script_userinit.json.attack_summary: reg.exe adds HKCU\Environment UserInitMprLogonScript pointing to a .bat file in Temp (Atomic Red Team T1037.001). Dev, not test: parser/detector rules were written after seeing this log.

techniques.T1037.001: Boot or Logon Initialization Scripts: Logon Script (Windows) - UserInitMprLogonScript set to a batch file

ie_version_registry.json.attack_summary: cmd.exe runs 'reg query HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Internet Explorer /v svcVersion' to find the browser version (Atomic Red Team T1518).

techniques.T1518: Software Discovery - reads the installed Internet Explorer version
techniques.T1012: Query Registry - uses reg query to read the value

wuauclt_dll_injection.json.attack_summary: A Covenant implant runs wuauclt.exe /UpdateDeploymentProvider with an attacker DLL (SimpleInjection.dll) and /RunHandlerComServer; the DLL injects into a spawned notepad.exe via CreateRemoteThread.

techniques.T1218: System Binary Proxy Execution - signed wuauclt.exe loads and runs an attacker DLL
techniques.T1055: Process Injection - the DLL injects code into notepad.exe (CreateRemoteThread)

reg_save_sam.json.attack_summary: An Empire PowerShell agent runs 'reg.exe save HKLM\sam sam' to copy the SAM hive for offline credential extraction.

techniques.T1003.002: OS Credential Dumping: Security Account Manager - the SAM hive is saved to a file

dumpert_lsass.json.attack_summary: cmd.exe runs Outflank-Dumpert.exe, which dumps LSASS process memory using direct system calls.

techniques.T1003.001: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory - LSASS memory is dumped

ntdsutil_ntds_dump.json.attack_summary: ntdsutil "ac i ntds" "ifm" "create full C:\Windows\Temp\..." copies the Active Directory database (NTDS.dit) via a shadow copy (Atomic Red Team T1003.003).

techniques.T1003.003: OS Credential Dumping: NTDS - ntdsutil IFM creates a copy of NTDS.dit

vbs_launcher_powershell.json.attack_summary: WScript.exe runs launcher.vbs, which starts an encoded PowerShell Empire stager; the agent then runs whoami.exe.

techniques.T1059.005: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Visual Basic - wscript.exe runs launcher.vbs
techniques.T1059.001: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell - powershell.exe -enc stager

dcom_excel4_macro.json.attack_summary: A Covenant implant runs MoveExcel4.exe against a remote host (172.18.39.6) to execute an Excel 4.0 macro over DCOM (lateral movement attempt; execution blocked on the target).

techniques.T1021.003: Remote Services: Distributed Component Object Model - Excel DCOM object used to execute on a remote host

uac_bypass_fodhelper.json.attack_summary: An Empire agent runs whoami /groups, then fodhelper.exe, which auto-elevates and launches hidden encoded PowerShell read from the registry (UAC bypass).

techniques.T1548.002: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Bypass User Account Control - fodhelper.exe auto-elevation
techniques.T1059.001: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell - hidden encoded powershell.exe

ldap_domain_users.json.attack_summary: A Covenant implant sends LDAP search requests to enumerate domain user accounts. The log has no process-creation events, so detection may find nothing; kept to report that honestly.

techniques.T1087.002: Account Discovery: Domain Account - LDAP queries for domain users
